parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the synchronization link.

parameters.name: KnowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the knowledge base.

parameters.name: LinkName
parameters.description: The name of the synchronization link.

parameters.name: McpEndpoint
parameters.description: The DingTalk document MCP Server endpoint.

parameters.name: SheetMcpEndpoint
parameters.description: The DingTalk spreadsheet MCP Server endpoint.

parameters.name: SourceDir
parameters.description: The source directory address for synchronization.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: The data source type. Valid values: FEISHU and SHAREPOINT.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: The tenant ID. This parameter is required when SourceType is set to SHAREPOINT.
